name: agent
title: Agent panel
description: A controlled agent conversation with streaming-friendly scrolling, Markdown with tables, links to app items drawn as chips, pasted images, tool traces, custom tool results, questions the agent asks with ask_user as one-click answers, suggestions, a context size in thousands of tokens and a model picker behind its badge. A right dock that widens and shows when a reply runs or waits unread, and a header switcher for earlier sessions. The host owns transport, tools, sessions and approvals. Includes Pi tool step titles and a model and thinking picker.
